# Psalm 19 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** For-the-choirmaster. A-psalm of-David.

**2** The-heavens declare the-glory of-God, and-the-work of-His-hands the-firmament proclaims.

**3** Day to-day pours-forth speech, and-night to-night reveals knowledge.

**4** There-is-no speech and-there-are-no words; not heard [is] their-voice.

**5** Into-all the-earth goes-out their-line, and-to-the-end of-the-world their-words. For-the-sun He-has-set a-tent in-them.

**6** And-it [is] like-a-bridegroom going-forth from-his-chamber; it-rejoices like-a-mighty-man to-run [its] course.

**7** From-the-end of-the-heavens [is] its-going-forth, and-its-circuit [is] to their-ends; and-nothing is-hidden from-its-heat.

**8** The-Torah of-YHWH [is] perfect, restoring the-soul. The-testimony of-YHWH [is] sure, making-wise the-simple.

**9** The-precepts of-YHWH [are] right, rejoicing the-heart. The-commandment of-YHWH [is] pure, enlightening the-eyes.

**10** The-fear of-YHWH [is] clean, enduring forever. The-judgments of-YHWH [are] true; they-are-righteous altogether.

**11** More-desirable [are they] than-gold, even-than-much fine-gold; and-sweeter than-honey and-the-drippings of-the-honeycomb.

**12** Also Your-servant is-warned by-them; in-keeping them [there is] great reward.

**13** Errors — who can-discern? From-hidden-faults acquit-me.

**14** Also from-presumptuous [sins] restrain Your-servant; let-them-not have-dominion over-me. Then I-shall-be blameless and-innocent of-great transgression.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **19:2**: The psalm has two halves: creation speaks (vv.1-7) and Torah speaks (vv.8-14). The same God who made the cosmos gave the Law.

- **19:5**: Qavam can mean 'line' (measuring line) or 'voice.' Paul quotes the LXX's 'voice' (phthongos) in Romans 10:18.

— EMET
